what: The plate is tilted −10° and split into 11×22px cells. On every second row, a run of characters (20~50 on wide screens, 10~30 on narrow) is laid at a random horizontal spot — runs switch on one after another at 50ms intervals, and the characters inside a run also switch on at 50ms intervals, cycling through four letters (ACGT) by .2 per tick and stopping at 50 ticks. Each run drifts up 1px per tick, and when it leaves the top it relights at a new spot from the bottom. It speeds up by amount scrolled/100, then slows by .95× per tick down to 1, and while sped up 10% of the runs flicker again. After 5.5 seconds the plate fades out over 2 seconds — the Hero background where base letters flow.

options.glyphs: Spinning letters, default ACGT — draws one cell per letter, starts from a random face and spins in turn
options.w · h: Cell size (px), default 11 · 22 — letters are drawn as h×.9 squares
options.min · max: Wide-screen (960px and up) characters per group, default 20 · 50
options.min-sp · max-sp: Character count per group on narrow screens, default 10 · 30
options.each: Interval at which groups and letters light up (ms), default 50
options.flip: Frames advanced per tick (PIXI animationSpeed), default .2
options.ttl: Number of ticks letters spin before stopping, default 50
options.decay: Multiplier by which the sped-up rate shrinks each tick, default .95
options.boost: Scroll px needed per +1 speed, default 100
options.hold: Seconds the panel stays, default 5.5 (original subpages use 4) — off means it never disappears
options.--fx-glyph-a · --fx-glyph-b · --fx-glyph: Front and back text color and font, default a background mixed with 14% accent · surface color · heading font

from.where: index.html #bg — original bganimation.js: pixi 6.5.9, stageAngle −10, charW 11·charH 22, groupCharas 20~50 (960px and up)·10~30, charTTL 50, charDelay 50ms, animationSpeed .2, groupSpeedRate .95, scroll difference/100 acceleration, on the first page after 5500ms gsap.to(#bg, opacity 0, display none, 2s)

note: The original text graphic (sprite png) is not used. It is drawn at the same cell size with the skin font (Teko 300 on the site). The original only set a blur filter to 0, so it was dropped. The panel does not block clicks (pointer-events: none)
